native_rule: Natural four-side faces retain their full target boundary and original UV domains with ReTrim=Yes. Exact target isocurves can be constructed directly without inverse projection fitting.
local_diagnostic: Initial eager previews exposed work limits and slow inverse fits on natural warped/curved boundaries. Exact natural isocurves and canonical straight UV contours avoid those fits while preserving topology. Early UI observers also confused active/invalid command text with an unfinished command; the final observer checks the command field and retains expected invalid-input errors.
limits: The local preview refreshes automatically; Rhino uses a Preview button. Native preview pixels, labels and update cadence are not compared.
Curve Rebuild previews, seam/singular retrimming, split natural-side specialization, general closest-point guarantees and performance parity remain unfinished or unverified.
